withheld_reasoning.reason: reasoning the model signed and withheld the text of: the AI SDK's telemetry exports no reasoning part for it, and no payload holds one

reasoning_signature.reason: the signature of reasoning the model withheld the text of: the AI SDK's telemetry exports the reasoning step as an empty part and drops its signature, which no payload holds

reasoning_output.reason: reasoning the model signed and withheld the text of, on the call that produced it: the AI SDK's telemetry leaves it out of that call's output, and only the next request's history re-sends it
